headline.text: Login from a new device abroad

context.text: 09:58 Rina reports: someone called saying they were from IT, asked for her OTP code, and she gave it to them.
Rina is in the office all day (attendance record).

explanation: Three minutes after Rina gave away her OTP, there was a successful login from a new device abroad, while Rina was in the office. Her account has been taken over, so the password must be reset right away.
hints: Compare the time of the phone call with the login times in the log.
Rina is in the office, but there is a login from abroad using the OTP she shared.
